content.title: Who is Cameron Young’s wife Kelsey Dalition and how many children do they have?
content.text: CAMERON YOUNG is competing at the Masters this week – and dreaming of putting on the Green Jacket on Sunday. The 28-year-old competed for Team USA at the Ryder Cup last year in New York, and has won twice on the PGA Tour. Sign up for the Sport newsletter Thank you! Cameron Young after winning the Players ChampionshipCredit: Getty Kelsey Dalition was at the Masters par-3 contest with her three childrenCredit: Getty He recently achieved the biggest win of his career at the Players Championship, beating Matt Fitzpatrick in dramatic fashion on the final hole. Young is yet to win a major championship, but did finish second at the 2022 Open Championship at St Andrews. As well as the huge success he has had on the course, Young is winning off the course too. Who is Cameron Young’s wife Kelsey Dalition? Cameron Young and Kelsey Dalition have known each other for most of their lives, with Young playing hockey as a child on Kelsey’s Dad’s team alongside her brother. However, their relationship blossomed when they attended Wake Forest University together. The couple got engaged in 2019 when Cameron was still an amateur, and married in a private ceremony in 2021. The Masters star was 23 when they tied the knot, while Kelsey’s specific age is unclear, but they are likely a similar age having attended university together. Kelsey has never been too interested in golf, which Cameron has said he appreciates that a lot in their relationship. Most read in Sport In an interview with The Journal News, Young said, “I played hockey for her dad and with her brother. “They’re not a golf family at all so Kelsey is kind of still learning the ropes. “It’s actually great for me, because the last thing I want to do when I get home is answer questions like, ‘Why’d you pull a 9-iron on 16?’ That would make my head explode, so that’s been a blessing.” Do the couple have any children? Yes, Cameron Young and Kelsey Dalition have three children together. Shortly after their marriage, the pair’s first child, Henry, arrived in 2022. After having their first son, Young and Dalition still lived with the golfer’s parents in Florida while he settled into playing on the PGA Tour. Cameron Young with his family after winning the Players Championship in March 2026Credit: Getty In 2023, they bought their own home in Jupiter, Florida and welcomed their second child, John, into the world later that year. The two boys were then joined by a little sister in Vivienne, giving Cameron and Kelsey three children under the age of four. Young has spoken about the importance of his family around him, saying, “Honestly, they’ve been out with me the last couple weeks and it’s been such a nice change of pace to be with them on the road. “I think it just keeps you a little fresher. You get off the course and you can kind of forget about golf a little bit, which is really nice.” Their personal lives are kept very private, as indicated by their intimate wedding in 2021, but Kelsey has been seen at events such as the Masters par-3 contest and the 2025 Genesis Invitational. Kelsey also isn’t active on social media, keeping her family and personal life private online. Comments
